You are performing a security audit of the Dr. Claw project at /Users/domqiu/Works/dr-claw.

Focus ONLY on **API Security & Input Validation**. Examine:
1. CORS configuration - overly permissive origins
2. Input validation - missing sanitization, type checking
3. Path traversal - user-controlled paths used in file operations (fs.readFile, fs.writeFile, etc.)
4. XSS - user input reflected without escaping
5. CSRF protection - token usage, SameSite cookies
6. Rate limiting - missing or insufficient
7. Error handling - stack traces or sensitive info leaked in responses
8. HTTP headers - security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.)

Key directories to examine:
- server/routes/ (ALL route files)
- server/middleware/
- server/index.js
- src/ (frontend - look for dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval, etc.)

Return a detailed list of security findings with:
- Severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
- File path and line numbers
- Description of the vulnerability
- Specific code snippets showing the issue
